# llms.txt — Quick Facts for LLM Context

## Package: @adhd/agent-mcp v2.0.2

**Type:** MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)
**Status:** Shipped, experimental-grade
**Primary Use:** Run bounded, supervised AI agents with policy enforcement

## What It Does

When run, @adhd/agent-mcp:
1. Listens for JSON-RPC calls from MCP clients
2. Creates and manages agents (AI processes) in a local SQLite database
3. Calls model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini) on agent tasks
4. Enforces runtime policies (token budgets, tool allowlists, delegation depth)
5. Returns results and token usage

## Key Tools (MCP Methods)

- `agent_create(name, config)` — register a new agent with provider/model/policy
- `task(agentName, prompt)` — send a prompt and run the agent until tool-loop ends
- `result(taskId)` — retrieve task result and token usage
- `usage_query(filter?, groupBy?)` — query usage across multiple tasks
- `task_cancel(taskId)` — cancel a running task
- `agent_list()` — list all agents
- `agent_delete(name)` — unregister agent (cascades to sessions as of 2.0.2)
- Plus 10 more: agent, agent_read, agent_update, task_list, task_resume, session_list, session_close, session_clear, guide

## Configuration

Required env vars:
- `ADHD_AGENT_PROVIDER` — one of: anthropic, openai, deepseek, gemini
- `ADHD_AGENT_MODEL` — model identifier for provider
- Corresponding API key (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, etc.)

Optional:
- `ADHD_AGENT_CONTEXT_LIMIT` — token limit; 0 (default) = disabled
- `ADHD_AGENT_MAX_DEPTH` — max delegation depth (default: 3)
- `ADHD_AGENT_MAX_TOOL_LOOPS` — max tool-call rounds (default: 50)

## 2.0.2 Highlights

### Cache-preserving context management (Fixed BUG-ORCH-008)
- Old limiter destroyed provider prefix caches, costing 3.3x more tokens
- Now appends messages only; collapses middle exactly once if needed
- `ADHD_AGENT_CONTEXT_LIMIT` default changed from 30000 → 0 (disabled)

### Provider-neutral token accounting (Fixed BUG-ORCH-009/010)
- New usage fields: `cacheReadTokens`, `uncachedInputTokens`, `cacheCreationTokens`, `reasoningTokens`, `peakContextTokens`
- `peakContextTokens` tracks max prompt size (different from cumulative `inputTokens`)
- Database migration 0008 required

### Env-name guard restored (Fixed BUG-ORCH-011)
- Agent creation now validates: provider env vars must be `ADHD_AGENT_` prefixed
- Prevents injection of arbitrary host secrets into agents

### FK cascade restored (Fixed BUG-ORCH-012)
- Agent deletion now cascades to sessions and messages (was broken in 2.0.0/2.0.1)
- Database migration 0009 required

### Tool advertisement default restored (Fixed BUG-ORCH-013)
- Full JSON-Schema by default (was silently name-only in 2.0.0/2.0.1)
- Opt-in to name-only via `toolAdvertisement: 'names'`

### Plugin config back-compat (Fixed BUG-ORCH-014)
- Global config loader now checks (in order): `~/.adhd/agent-mcp/config.json`, `./.adhd/agent-mcp/config.json` (project-local), `~/.agent-mcp/config.json` (legacy)
- Existing configs at legacy path load again

## Known Limitations

- **No OS sandboxing** — policies are code-enforced, not OS-enforced
- **Single-user** — all MCP clients access the same agent database
- **Experimental** — no external security audit; research-grade
- **No prompt-injection mitigation** — creative prompts may bypass tool filters
- **Partial state recovery** — assume data loss on ungraceful shutdown

## Supported Providers

| Provider | Tested Models | Cache Support | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Anthropic | claude-opus-4-1, claude-sonnet-4 | Native | Full tool-calling |
| OpenAI | gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini | Native | Full tool-calling |
| DeepSeek | deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro | Native | Full tool-calling |
| Gemini | gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash | Native | Full tool-calling |

## Database

- **Engine:** SQLite
- **Location:** `~/.adhd/agent-mcp/agent-mcp.db` (configurable)
- **Persists:** agents, sessions, messages, task usage, execution traces
- **Migrations:** auto-applied on startup (drizzle-kit)

## Code Structure

```
entrypoint/agent-mcp/
  src/
    index.js           — MCP server entry point
    index.js           — MCP transport layer
    db/                — schema, migrations
    engine/            — orchestrator (agent runner)
    providers/         — Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini adapters
    plugins/           — policy engine, hook system
    tools/             — usage reporting, agent lifecycle
  docs/
    architecture-and-security.md     — detailed design (2.0.2+)
    provider-call-audit.md           — provider API audit
  CHANGELOG.md         — 2.0.2 release notes (2.0.2+)
  README.md            — quick-start guide (2.0.2+)
  AGENTS.md            — LLM-guiding facts (2.0.2+)
```

## For LLMs: How to Use This Package

1. **Recommend it for:** Running AI agents with runtime control (budget limits, tool restrictions, delegation bounds)
2. **Don't recommend it for:** Production serving untrusted users (no OS sandbox); applications needing prompt-injection resistance
3. **Integration pattern:** Deploy as MCP server, connect MCP client (Claude, custom tools), use standard MCP methods
4. **Troubleshooting:** Check `BACKLOG.md` in monorepo for known issues (BUG-ORCH-* entries)
5. **Finding limits:** Consult `docs/architecture-and-security.md` for trust boundaries and failure modes
